description: Sessions/pageviews/bounce-rate time series for a project's own tracking snippet. FREE — first-party data collected by MisarSEO's own snippet (/api/analytics/snippet.js), never a paid or rate-limited third-party call. `totals.bounceRate` is null (not 0) when there were no sessions in the range.
